title: Safeway for U — grocery rewards, member deals and coupons (program)
offer_text: Safeway for U — Grocery Rewards — Grocery Coupons — Loyalty Program. The forU program is a free customer loyalty program offered by Albertsons Companies, Inc. that allows participants to receive weekly personalized deals on groceries, earn Points on all eligible purchases, use Points for discounts on gas and groceries, receive an annual birthday treat, receive a free item every month, and more.
verbatim_source_text: forU program is a free customer loyalty program offered by Albertsons Companies, Inc. (“we”, “us”, “our”) (“Program”) that allows the participants of the Program (“Program Members” or individually, “Program Member”, “You” or “you”) to receive weekly personalized deals on groceries, earn Points on all eligible purchases, use Points for discounts on gas and groceries, receive an annual birthday treat, receive a free item every month, and more (“Rewards”)!
expiry_basis: Standing loyalty program; individual clipped deals carry their own expiry inside the account.
requirements: Free for U account (sign up in store or online)
Clip each deal to your account before shopping — clipped deals are tied to your account/phone number
Give your phone number or scan the app at the register

bay_area.note: Safeway operates many stores across San Francisco, the East Bay, the Peninsula, the South Bay and the North Bay. When the for U guest page was fetched on 2026-09-22 it resolved a Bay Area store context (the page header showed a store at '5100 Broadway'), and the site's own store locator is linked from the same page.

title: Costco Member-Only Savings / Instant Savings (program)
publisher: Costco — costco.com and the Costco app
offer_text: MEMBER-ONLY SAVINGS — IN-WAREHOUSE + ONLINE. Instant Savings is applied per item number with a stated purchase limit, and the discounted figure is published as 'YOUR COST'. 'Download the new COSTCO APP to your smartphone for Warehouse Savings promotions!' 'Promotions differ in Puerto Rico and Costco Business Centers.'
expiry_basis: Instant Savings runs in dated cycles (the community-reported cycle in force at verification was 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-18, which is NOT asserted as verified — see flags).
requirements: No clipping: instant savings apply automatically at the register to the listed item numbers
Observe the per-item purchase limit printed with each offer
For warehouse-specific promotions, use the Warehouse tab in the Costco app

bay_area.note: Costco operates warehouses throughout the nine-county Bay Area and its Instant Savings are national in-warehouse promotions. Selection varies by location, as Costco's own offer text states.

sources.title: MEMBER-ONLY SAVINGS (Costco offers page)
sources.evidence: Offer-page text captured from the official domain: 'MEMBER-ONLY SAVINGS', 'IN-WAREHOUSE + ONLINE', 'Instant Savings –$50.00 YOUR COST $99.99', 'SAVE $150 INSTANTLY on ANY SET OF 4 Bridgestone Tires ($70 Off any set of 4 Bridgestone tires + $80 additional member savings.)', 'Download the new COSTCO APP to your smartphone for Warehouse Savings promotions!', 'Promotions differ in Puerto Rico and Costco Business Centers.' Direct retrieval of this URL on 2026-09-22 returned Costco's own 'Page Not Found!' page, so the offer listing had rotated.

checks: Program mechanics (instant savings, item numbers, purchase limits, 'YOUR COST' presentation, app-based warehouse savings) confirmed from Costco's own offer-page text
Confirmed that both /coupons.html and /online-offers.html return Costco's 404 page when fetched directly on 2026-09-22
Current item-level offers and cycle dates were NOT verified and are deliberately not asserted

flags.detail: No specific Costco item, price or discount amount is asserted as current in this dataset. The offer listing rotates on a roughly four-week cycle and the public URL returned a 404 when fetched on 2026-09-22, so item-level offers must be confirmed in the Costco app (Warehouse tab) or on the printed in-warehouse savings book.

Community sources (r/Costco, citing Wallet Hacks and Costco Insider scans) reported the current Instant Savings book as 'Valid September 21 - October 18 2026' and the previous one as 'Valid August 24 - September 20, 2026'. These dates are plausible and consistent with the P&G/Costco rebate window verified on getpgoffer.com (8/24/26–9/20/26), but they come from unofficial scans, not from Costco. They are recorded here for review only and are not used to date any offer in this dataset.

Requires a paid Costco membership. Costco's own offer text describes its savings as 'Instant Savings' applied to listed item numbers rather than as clipped coupons; whether Costco accepts third-party manufacturer coupons was NOT verified from an official Costco source in this pass and is therefore not asserted here.

title: Target Circle — free membership with exclusive discounts and rewards (program)
offer_text: Target Circle is designed to make every Target run more rewarding — combining rewards and personalized value with exclusive discounts and flexible fulfillment options like same-day delivery and fast shipping. Guests can join Target Circle for free on Target.com, via the Target app or in checkout lanes in stores. — Target Circle: Free membership with exclusive discounts and Target Circle Rewards. Target Circle 360: Paid membership tier that unlocks ... free, fast shipping, same-day delivery, monthly freebies and members-only access to shop big sales and brand collaborations early.
expiry_basis: Standing program. The example sale event cited (Deal Days) ran 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-27 and has ended.
requirements: Free Target Circle account — can be joined in the checkout lane of a physical Target store
Circle offers apply to your account; the paid Circle 360 tier is optional

bay_area.note: Target operates stores throughout the Bay Area and its own release states members can join 'in checkout lanes in stores', so enrollment and redemption both happen physically.

sources.title: Target Circle Deal Days Highlights Top Seasonal Trends at Big Discounts
sources.evidence: Program description and tier definitions read verbatim from Target's own press release dated March 2026; the same release states the Deal Days event ran 'March 25–27' with 'up to 50% off thousands of items across apparel, home, beauty and more for members of the retailer's free-to-join Target Circle program, plus early access beginning March 24 for members of Target Circle 360'.

checks: Program existence, free tier and paid tier confirmed on Target's own corporate newsroom
Confirmed the cited sale event is historical, so its discount depth is not presented as a current offer
No current Circle offer amount is asserted

flags.detail: The 'up to 50% off' figure belongs to Target Circle Deal Days, 25–27 March 2026, which ended about six months before verification. It is quoted only as evidence of how the program works.

Third-party pages found during research quoted a Circle 360 price of $99/year. That price does not appear in the official Target release that was verified, so it is deliberately NOT stated in this dataset. Confirm the current price on target.com.
Circle offers are personalised per account, so they cannot be verified anonymously.
